name: Bridgewest Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Bridgewest Ventures (bridgewest.ventures; site footer '© 2026 | Bridgewest Ventures NZ LP'; also styled BVNZ), the New Zealand deep-tech incubator and venture arm of the privately held Bridgewest Group (bridgewestgroup.com). The fund-list name 'Bridgewest Ventrues' is a misspelling. The $37M fund in the lead is Bridgewest Venture Fund I LP (the firm also writes 'Bridgewest Ventures Fund I LP'), its first fund open to outside investors: first close NZ$55.3M (firm post, 16 Mar 2026), 'approximately NZ$60.2 million' first close (Pulse 2.0, 23 May 2026, the lead's date), NZ$62.7M / A$51.6M total commitments (firm post, 6 Jul 2026); no page states $37M, which looks like a USD conversion. Offices in Auckland (Level 11, 205 Queen St) and Wellington, plus a US address shared with Bridgewest Group in Coral Gables, FL; region recorded from the NZ headquarters. Relationship: Bridgewest Group is a US-headquartered private investment group (private equity, venture capital, real estate, lending; portfolio incl. BioDuro-Sundia, BioAtla and Provoke Solutions); Bridgewest Ventures calls itself the group's 'venture capital platform' / 'innovation engine' established in 2020, and the group's Venture Capital section (Life Science, MedTech, Deep Tech, Green VC) points to it. The group's locations page lists San Diego addresses for portfolio companies BioAtla and BioDuro-Sundia, not for the group itself. In Australia it holds AFSL 700178 for fund distribution; the group also lists an Australian address (Thebarton, SA) and BioCina. Invest Auckland describes the group's NZ arms as real estate, Bridgewest Finance NZ (lending), a private-equity arm (Provoke Solutions, SuiteFiles, ProjectWorks) and Bridgewest Ventures NZ (pre-seed and seed); PE-arm deals are not recorded here. Not Bridgewest Capital, Bridge West LLP or other similarly named firms.
